items.title: After eating
items.cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said when his meal was cleared away
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
items.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaahi katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin walaa muwadda'in walaa mustaghnan 'anhu rabbanaa
items.translation: All praise is for Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise; [praise] that is never enough, never bid farewell to, and never done without, our Lord.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 5458: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/8163

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 5458 (comparison only)

items.title: When angry
items.cue: The word that takes anger away
items.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the outcast.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6115: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9157

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 6115 (comparison only)

usage.evidence: Two men insulted each other, one red-faced with anger. The Prophet ﷺ said: I know a word which, if he said it, what he feels would leave him (al-Bukhari 6115).

items.title: In distress
items.cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said at times of distress
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahul-'azeemul-haleem, laa ilaha illallaahu rabbul-'arshil-'azeem, laa ilaha illallaahu rabbus-samaawaati warabbul-ardi warabbul-'arshil-kareem
items.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the noble Throne.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6346: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9517

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 6346 (comparison only)

provenance.note: The printed al-Sultaniyya text on Shamela writes السماوات with its long alif; hadith-api writes السموات. The words are the same; we follow the printed edition.

items.title: Entering the mosque
items.cue: "O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy"
items.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 713: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1585

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-muslim, hadith 713 (comparison only)

items.title: If you forgot to say Bismillah
items.cue: What to say on remembering Allah's name partway through a meal
items.translation: In the name of Allah, at its start and end.

gradings.in: Jami' al-Tirmidhi, after hadith 1858 (al-Nawawi quotes this verdict for the hadith in al-Adhkar, no. 653)

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 3767: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/5215

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-abudawud, hadith 3767 (comparison only)

when: Eating: say Bismillah at the start; if you forgot, say this when you remember
usage.evidence: When one of you eats, let him mention the name of Allah; if he forgets at the start, let him say this (Abu Dawud 3767). Al-Tirmidhi relates it with the words في أوله وآخره (1858).

items.title: Breaking the fast
items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.

gradings.in: Sunan al-Daraqutni, Kitab al-Siyam, after hadith 2279 (Mu'assasat al-Risala edition, vol. 3 p. 156)
gradings.quote: تَفَرَّدَ بِهِ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، وَإِسْنَادُهُ حَسَنٌ

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 2357: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/3158

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-abudawud, hadith 2357 (comparison only)

usage.evidence: Ibn Umar said that when the Prophet ﷺ broke his fast he said this (Abu Dawud 2357).

variants.label: Also related: "O Allah, for You I fasted, and with Your provision I break my fast." Mursal: Mu'adh ibn Zuhrah relays it from the Prophet ﷺ without naming who told him. Al-Nawawi: "هكذا رواه مرسلا" (al-Adhkar, no. 545).
variants.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ، وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ

items.title: Asking Allah to choose
items.cue: The istikhara the Prophet ﷺ taught like a surah of the Quran
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ، فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي، أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ، فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ رَضِّنِي بِهِ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma innee astakheeruka bi'ilmik, wa'astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa'as'aluka min fadlikal-'azeem, fa'innaka taqdiru walaa aqdir, wata'lamu walaa a'lam, wa'anta 'allaamul-ghuyoob, allaahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun lee fee deenee wama'aashee wa'aaqibati amree, aw qaala fee 'aajili amree wa'aajilih, faqdurhu lee, wa'in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun lee fee deenee wama'aashee wa'aaqibati amree, aw qaala fee 'aajili amree wa'aajilih, fasrifhu 'annee wasrifnee 'anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kaana thumma raddinee bih
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You to choose for me by Your knowledge, I ask You to empower me by Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty; for You are able and I am not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affair (or he said: in my affair now and later), then decree it for me. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affair (or he said: in my affair now and later), then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me the good wherever it is, then make me content with it.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6382: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9573

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 6382 (comparison only)

provenance.note: The printed al-Sultaniyya text on Shamela reads أو قال في عاجل أمري in both places; hadith-api has أو قال عاجل أمري in the first. We follow the printed edition.

when: When deciding a matter: pray two rak'ahs, then say this, naming the matter at "this matter"
usage.evidence: Jabir said the Prophet ﷺ taught them istikhara in all matters as he taught a surah of the Quran: when one of you intends a matter, let him pray two rak'ahs, then say this, and name his need (al-Bukhari 6382). "Or he said" marks a narrator unsure which of the two phrases was used.

items.title: Leaving home
items.cue: "In the name of Allah, I rely on Allah…"
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillaah, tawakkaltu 'alallaah, laa hawla walaa quwwata illaa billaah
items.translation: In the name of Allah. I rely on Allah. There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 5095: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/6957

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-abudawud, hadith 5095 (comparison only)

when: On going out of the house
usage.evidence: Whoever says this on leaving his house, it is said to him: you are guided, sufficed and protected, and the devils move away from him (Abu Dawud 5095). Al-Tirmidhi relates it more briefly (3426): you are sufficed and protected, and Satan moves away from him.

items.title: Leaving the mosque
items.cue: "O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty"
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 713: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1585

witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 1032: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/1682

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 1032 (comparison only)

items.title: Sneezing
items.cue: What the one who sneezes says, the reply, and the answer to it

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6224: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9316

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 6224 (comparison only)

variants.label: The one who hears says: "May Allah have mercy on you."
The one who sneezed answers: "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right."

items.title: Stopping at a place
items.cue: What to say on halting at a place on a journey
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 2708: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/6812

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-muslim, hadith 2708 (comparison only)

usage.evidence: Whoever stops at a place and says this, nothing will harm him until he moves on from it (Muslim 2708).

items.title: Entering the toilet
items.cue: Refuge from the male and female devils
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa'ith
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil ones, male and female [devils].

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 142: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/256

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 142 (comparison only)

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan Abi Dawud, ed. Muhyi al-Din Abd al-Hamid, hadith 30: https://shamela.ws/book/1726/48

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-abudawud, hadith 30 (comparison only)

when: On coming out of the toilet

items.title: Setting out on a journey
items.cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said once mounted for a journey
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Subhaana lladhee sakhkhara lanaa hadhaa wamaa kunnaa lahu muqrineen, wa'innaa ilaa rabbinaa lamunqaliboon, allaahumma innaa nas'aluka fee safarinaa hadhal-birra wat-taqwaa, waminal-'amali maa tardaa, allaahumma hawwin 'alaynaa safaranaa hadhaa watwi 'annaa bu'dah, allaahumma antas-saahibu fis-safar, wal-khaleefatu fil-ahl, allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safar, waka'aabatil-manzar, wasoo'il-munqalabi fil-maali wal-ahl
items.translation: Glory be to the One who has made this subservient to us, when we could not have managed it ourselves; and to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and mindfulness of You, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who looks after the family. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the hardship of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil return to wealth and family.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 1342: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/3201

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-muslim, hadith 1342 (comparison only)

provenance.note: The Shamela copy of the printed text runs واطو عنا together as one word; hadith-api writes them apart, as we do.

when: Once mounted for a journey, after saying Allahu akbar three times
usage.evidence: Ibn Umar taught that when the Prophet ﷺ settled on his camel to set out on a journey he said Allahu akbar three times, then this (Muslim 1342). Its opening words are from the Quran, 43:13-14.

items.title: Worry and debt
items.cue: Refuge from worry, grief, helplessness and debt
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhl, wadala'id-dayni waghalabatir-rijaal
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6369: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9554

witnesses.name: hadith-api
witnesses.ref: fawazahmed0/hadith-api, edition ara-bukhari, hadith 6369 (comparison only)

when: When worried, or at any time
